bio: Indulge in the timeless English tradition of Afternoon Tea amid cosy fireplaces and breath-taking views in Cast Iron Grill and Oak Hall.  Delight in tasty finger sandwiches, delicate pastries and a grand tea selection inspired by the hotel’s idyllic countryside surroundings.  Located in Ware, Hertfordshire on 200 acres of beautiful countryside, Hanbury Manor Marriott Hotel & Country Club was built in the Jacobean style by Edmund Hanbury in 1890, sparing no expense on a home for his new bride. A further wing was added 60 years later when the house became a convent and boarding school. In 1990, it opened as a hotel and country club.
